verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim's ROS 2 bridge lets robot stacks validated in simulation be evaluated via software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing, and Isaac ROS packages are explicitly designed to run unchanged on both workstations and embedded Jetson hardware, which is the core of write-once run-in-sim-and-on-robot. missing for 10: independent/hands-on case study confirming zero code changes between sim and real deployment, and no mention of common friction points (sensor timing, physics mismatch) that engineers typically must handle.
